summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) using the shared venv's Python. Nothing is committed. Deviation: I added an explicit non-Node guard, because None as a subject acts as a wildcard in Graph.triples and would otherwise return wrong paths. Under warn_unreachable, mypy may flag that guard, but mypy isn't installed, so I couldn't verify it. black and isort also weren't run; line lengths were checked by hand.
